name: disk-reclaim
description: Recover disk space on a macOS developer laptop without losing anyone's work: read the APFS container, census read-only, ask the other live Claude Code sessions (typed silence: dead, timeout, held-for-approval), record every ask and verdict, remove only through a ledger-gated executor that stamps who acted, run unattended as a locked orchestrator firing that writes a decision card, and reclaim automatically under a free-space target (spool rotation, old Claude CLI versions, idle job scratch, then dehydrate --pressure), every action ledger-recorded.
